The scanner reads vllm 0.29.0rc1+amzn2023 from dist-info METADATA, but this image builds from vllm commit 98dff2a81d747d1dba01a47f939f48c3526d4206, which is the v0.29.0 release tag itself and therefore carries the cache_salt length-validation fix. The version string in the wheel metadata is stale; correcting it is the real remedy.

nltk 3.10.3 with no fixed version published. The path traversal is in the TransitionParser model-artifact APIs, which require a caller to pass attacker-controlled paths; this image serves a fixed model and never loads untrusted artifacts through those APIs. Not exploitable in the runtime.

accelerate 1.12.0 with no fixed version published (the advisory covers through 1.14.0). load_checkpoint_in_model and load_checkpoint_and_dispatch traverse paths taken from a sharded checkpoint index, so exploitation needs an attacker-supplied checkpoint; this image serves a fixed, known model. HF-owned package, so a bump would go to the HF team once a fix exists.
